sloka: तस्य रोषाभिभूतस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।तेजोमया मरीच्यस्तु सर्वगात्रैर्विनिष्पतन् ।। ७.६८.९ ॥
transliteration: tasya roṣābhibhūtasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।tejomayā marīcyastu sarvagātrairviniṣpatan ।। 7.68.9 ॥

translations.english: From the great-souled Shatrughna, who was overcome by such rage, radiant rays of light emanated from all his limbs.
